initial_description:
Based on the methodology section and figure caption provided, here is a detailed description of the illustrative diagram.

### **Overall Figure Description**

This is a two-panel, double-column-width figure for a top-tier academic publication, designed to be elegant, clean, and professional. The entire figure has a pure white background, promoting clarity and generous white space between all elements. A thin, very light gray vertical line separates the two panels. All text uses a Serif font (e.g., Times New Roman), with mathematical notations rendered in Computer Modern. A consistent, muted, and harmonious color palette is used throughout. All rectangular boxes feature 8px rounded corners and a subtle, soft drop shadow (2px offset, 10% opacity) to give them a slight lift from the background.

---

### **Panel (a): Training Setup**

This panel, taking up the left ~53% of the total width, illustrates the model's training architecture in a vertical flowchart that flows from bottom to top. It is labeled **(a) Training Setup** in the top-left corner.

**1. Input Layer (Bottom):**
*   **Component:** A single, horizontally-centered box at the base of the diagram is labeled "RGB Observation".
*   **Styling:** This box has a light cool gray fill, a slightly darker cool gray border, and contains text in a smaller, 8pt font.

**2. Encoder Layer (Middle-Bottom):**
*   **Components:** Two encoder boxes are positioned side-by-side above the input.
    *   The left box is labeled **DINOv2** with an italicized gray subtitle below it reading "1024-d patches".
    *   The right box is labeled **SigLIP** with an italicized gray subtitle reading "1152-d patches".
*   **Styling:** Both encoder boxes share the same style: a soft sky blue fill with a medium-dark blue border. The main labels are 9pt bold, and subtitles are 7.5pt italic gray.
*   **Connections:** Two separate, thin black arrows originate from the top of the "RGB Observation" box and diverge, each pointing to the bottom of one of the encoder boxes.

**3. Backbone Layer (Middle):**
*   **Component:** A single, wide box labeled **LLM Backbone** is centered above the two encoders, spanning their combined width. It has an italicized gray subtitle below it reading "Llama-2 7B + LoRA".
*   **Styling:** This box has a light beige fill with a soft taupe border.
*   **Connections:** Two thin black arrows emerge from the top of each encoder box and converge, pointing to the bottom center of the LLM Backbone box. A small, 7pt italic gray annotation, "concat (2176-d)", is placed precisely at the point where these two data streams meet, just below the LLM box.

**4. Output Heads (Top):**
*   **Components:** Two output head boxes are located at the top of the diagram, branching from the LLM.
    *   **Action Head (Top-Left):** A box labeled **Action Head** with the subtitle "7-DoF tokens". Above this box is a mathematical label, **_L_<sub>action</sub>**, rendered in a bold, medium green color.
    *   **Aux Head (Top-Right):** A box labeled **Aux Head** with the subtitle "BEV / Depth". Above this box is a mathematical label, **λ(t) ⋅ _L_<sub>aux</sub>**, rendered in a bold, warm gold color. A small, rounded badge with a muted red border containing the text "BN/LN" is placed near the top-right of this box.
*   **Styling:**
    *   The Action Head box has a light mint green fill and a medium green border.
    *   The Aux Head box has a light peach fill and a warm gold border.
*   **Connections:** Two thin black arrows diverge from the top of the LLM Backbone box, one pointing to the bottom of the Action Head and the other to the bottom of the Aux Head.

**5. Key Annotations and Visual Elements:**
*   **Gradient Flow Arrow:** The central visual element of this panel is a **dashed, muted red arrow** (1.4pt thickness) that originates from the "Aux Head" and curves gracefully back down, pointing towards the "LLM Backbone" area. This arrow signifies the core research question about gradient flow.
*   **Gradient Flow Question:** Adjacent to this red arrow is a prominent annotation box. It has a thin, muted red border, a light pink background, and contains the italicized text "**_gradient flow?_**" in the same muted red color.
*   **Inference Annotation:** Above the "Aux Head" box, there is a small annotation on a light yellow background with a thin border that reads "_discarded at inference_" in 7pt italic gray. A small, thin arrow points from this note down to the Aux Head box.

---

### **Panel (b): Factorial Design**

This panel, occupying the right ~45% of the figure, displays the 2x2 factorial experimental design in a clean grid format. It is labeled **(b) Factorial Design** in the top-left corner.

**1. Grid Layout and Headers:**
*   **Structure:** A 2x2 grid is the main feature, enclosed within a single outer rounded rectangle with a light gray border and a subtle drop shadow. The internal grid lines are thin and very light gray.
*   **Column Headers:** Positioned above the grid. The left column header is "**Gradient ON**" in a muted red color. The right column header is "**Gradient OFF**" in a dusty purple color. Both are 8.5pt bold.
*   **Row Headers:** Positioned to the left of the grid. The top row header is "**BN**" and the bottom row header is "**LN**". Both are 9pt bold in a dark navy blue color.

**2. Grid Cells:**
Each of the four cells contains an inner, centered, rounded box with a tinted background and a bold text label.
*   **Top-Left (BN, ON):** Labeled "**Full OCC**". The text is muted red, and the background is a very light pink/red tint.
*   **Top-Right (BN, OFF):** Labeled "**Detach OCC**". The text is dusty purple, and the background is a very light lavender tint.
*   **Bottom-Left (LN, ON):** Labeled "**Full OCC+LN**". The text is warm gold, and the background is a very light peach tint.
*   **Bottom-Right (LN, OFF):** Labeled "**Detach+LN**". The text is soft taupe, and the background is a very light beige tint.

**3. Supplementary Conditions:**
*   **Layout:** Below the main grid, there is a small section titled "**Additional:**" in 8pt bold. Below this title, four supplementary conditions are listed in a two-column layout.
*   **Items:** Each item consists of a small colored square marker followed by 7.5pt text.
    *   `■` Random OCC (medium green square)
    *   `■` Depth-only (goldenrod square)
    *   `■` Cutoff / Reverse (soft cyan square)
    *   `■` Vanilla (no aux) (medium-dark blue square)

**4. Final Annotation:**
*   **Text:** At the very bottom of the panel, centered, is a 7pt italic gray text block that reads:
    "_5 factors across 12 conditions:_"
    "_gradient flow / label content / normalization_"
    "_reference frame / temporal extent_"
